scope: Production native ExportSettings helpers against actual DocumentConversion declarations, real fixture shells/Pandoc/files; no GUI or user preference/command execution
limits: User commands retain source cwd; arbitrary command side effects cannot be rolled back.
Folder commit is a rollback-capable batch, not a directory-wide atomic replacement. Conflicting file/directory types fail without deleting unrelated contents.

NUL arguments and environment values fail before spawn
timeout: group descendants stop and the leader is reaped once
cancel: group descendants stop and the leader is reaped once
Successful background descendant does not hold capture open on pipe EOF

checks.name: Official path/name macros and source cwd reach the actual shell consumer
Macros preserve single/double quotes, literal escapes and nested metadata without evaluation
Snapshot input is current UTF-8, private and removed while original remains exact
No-dialog commands have empty output macros rather than a source destination
Custom command NUL cannot silently truncate executable text
Folder commit replaces produced names and recursively retains unrelated files/source
A later folder conflict rolls back replaced and newly created entries
Folder source collision is rejected without changing original bytes
File commit is atomic and a missing output preserves its prior target
An intentionally empty regular command output remains valid
Folder transaction recovery materials are cleaned after success and rollback
Pandoc argv splitting retains empty quoted args, spaces and literal backslashes
Exact, compact, clustered and abbreviated transport/default flags are rejected
Ordinary Pandoc resources and extra input paths retain argv semantics
Real Pandoc receives valid PNG/default and SVG WebTeX URLs
Structured global title/author become real Pandoc metadata
Native normalization avoids reserved/duplicate IDs and freeze rejects removed entries
Native PDF/Markdown defaults and boolean JSON values agree with consumers
Actual JSON roundtrip keeps toggles boolean and dimensions/quality numeric
UI format options override legacy custom entry extras
Post folder inheritance honors absent/explicit false and opens on MainActor
Post shell runs asynchronously, receives metadata and presents on MainActor
Post Task cancellation reaches process group and suppresses late UI
